name: Phoenix Forge

features.name: Tumbling paylines
features.description: Winning symbols tumble away on a 3x5, 20-line grid.

features.name: Hot Spot Multipliers
features.description: Winning cells are marked and their multipliers increase with every tumble.

features.name: Phoenix bonus
features.description: Three or more phoenix symbols trigger free spins.

review:
A 20-line game that tumbles – on paylines rather than clusters. When symbols win, their cells get marked, and the multiplier on those spots grows with every tumble.

These Hot Spot Multipliers work in the base game and free spins, and three phoenix symbols trigger the bonus. Position multipliers on a line game are rare, which makes this a nice change. Up to 5,000x, 96.51% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
